name: clover-for-developers
description: Clover's security assistant for developers. Kick off a security/design review on the change you are working on, get security feedback on a design document (a link to it), and read back the reviews you have access to — answered in natural language, right inside your coding agent.

streaming_url.title: Clover streaming URL
streaming_url.description: Base URL of your Clover environment. Leave the default unless Clover runs in your own environment (e.g. https://streaming.acme.example.com).
